title: OSD and applet: add "Extend to top/bottom" options
line: The display OSD and the Display Configuration applet now offer "Extend above" and "Extend below" the built-in screen, next to left and right.
explanation: The quick layout presets in KScreen's OSD (Meta+P) and the Display Configuration applet only knew how to put the other screen to the left or right of the built-in one, so a laptop under a monitor (the common setup in the report) needed a trip to System Settings. Both lists come from OsdAction::availableActions(), and there were no matching icons in Breeze. kscreen gets ExtendAbove and ExtendBelow actions, placed like the left/right ones but along the vertical axis using the logical height of the screen on top; the OSD buttons now shrink when eight of them wouldn't fit in 80% of the screen width (unchanged on screens wider than about 1500 px). breeze-icons gets osd-sbs-above and osd-sbs-below at 32, 48, 64 and 128 px.

commits.message:
osd: add actions to extend above and below the built-in screen

The OSD and the applet could only put the other screen to the left or
right of the built-in one. Add actions to extend above and below it, and
let the OSD buttons shrink so that the longer row fits narrow screens.

BUG: 406377

applets: add osd-sbs-above and osd-sbs-below icons

KScreen's OSD and applet get actions to extend the desktop above or
below the built-in screen. These icons show them in the style of
osd-sbs-left and osd-sbs-sright, with the two screens stacked instead.

BUG: 406377
